errors.text_span: 本柱状图显示了每日新增确诊人数与每日新冠核酸检测数的变化趋势。
errors.evidence: The chart shows daily new COVID-19 cases and related news media reports, not daily COVID-19 testing numbers.

errors.text_span: 水平轴表示日期，从2022年1月1日开始，一直延伸到2023年1月1日，日期顺序为升序排列。
errors.evidence: The x-axis represents dates from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, not January 1, 2022, to January 1, 2023.

errors.text_span: 右侧表示每日新冠-19检测数，单位为“份”，其刻度从0到6000，线性刻度间隔为1000.
errors.evidence: The right y-axis represents daily COVID-19-related news reports, not daily testing numbers.
The left y-axis interval is 200,000, not 20,000.

errors.text_span: 最短的柱状图代表2022年1月2日，高度约为8000人；最长的柱状图代表2022年12月20日，高度约为165000人。
errors.evidence: The chart does not include data for January 2, 2022, or December 20, 2022. The shortest and tallest bars are within the July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, range.
The description does not mention that the chart illustrates the relationship between daily new COVID-19 cases and related news media reports.
The description does not mention the y-axis intervals for the right axis (1,000) or the left axis (200,000).
The description does not mention the synchronization trend between the two data series (cases and news reports) or the lag effect observed in the peaks.
The description does not mention the weekly intervals on the x-axis.
The description does not mention the color coding of the chart (blue-green for bars and blue for the line).
